title: Chapter 23 The Imperial Guard

Chapter 23 The Imperial Guard

Praetorian

Some have been rigorously trained since childhood, proficient in all killing techniques, and have undergone many battle tests, and selected veterans who have experienced hundreds of battles. Although he does not have extraordinary power, almost everyone can compete with ten, and he is a rare elite soldier.

Morale: High (they are fearless in the face of all challenges!)

Loyal, die-hard (will not question any command of their master, and will carry it out without hesitation!)

Number of people: 100 (this is an army large enough to maintain the authority of your dominion!)

"Hahaha, hahaha" I finally laughed outrageously without any image in my heart. Sure enough, the system still takes care of me, or my luck is really the son of destiny. I can do whatever I want, and I finally have it. An army that absolutely obeys his orders and is absolutely loyal to himself.

Instead of being like those Yellow Turbans, they were born thieves and did not know loyalty. They also have to win over themselves in every possible way. If there is a little bit that does not meet their wishes, their loyalty to him will plummet.

Now, because too many people have died, the loyalty of the Yellow Turbans is already in a state of disappointment. Those barbarians are even more in a state of hatred. If it weren't for the suppression of the three hundred young men, they would really likely die at any time because of the rebellion of the army under them.

But now, everything is uncertain, who is playing with who, who is worried about who's cleaning? Everything is still unknown!

With this army, he had already made a plan before, because of the lack of troops and the distrust and uncooperation of the people. In order to ensure their own safety and authority, the plan that was forced to stop can now be carried out?

I don't know what those schadenfreude territorial people, the army that is just about to move, will think in their hearts when they see that they suddenly have such a powerful army that is absolutely loyal to them?

It should be incomparable disappointment and fear, after all, they were not very friendly to themselves before!

And how would that cruel lord treat them? What kind of cruel treatment should these people who have actually been regarded as betrayer be treated?

Zhong Yu thought so happily in his heart, and a cold smile appeared on his mouth, which made the surrounding air become cold several degrees. had a bad feeling.

Although the population recruited through the refugee camp is more than the population directly exchanged for luck points, there is such a drawback. Their loyalty is not too high, and they are not as loyal as the population who directly exchange lucky points with the system. Those populations are loyal enough.

If the surrounding situation is not too dangerous, there are barbarians everywhere, and they need their own lord to lead them and live in this dangerous world, these refugees who have been distorted by life.

How could he listen to his own wealth so seriously, I am afraid he has already overthrown himself, plundered his own wealth, occupied his own mansion, and drove himself out or killed him directly!

However, it is too uneconomical to exchange fortune points for population. Zhong Yu just learned from the system that one luck point can be exchanged for ten people, 100 luck points, which is 1,000 people.

Although he is loyal enough to himself, the population base is too small! Well, if you go to exchange for a refugee camp, 100 luck points can be exchanged for a junior camp (novice benefit, canceled after the founding of the country).

A primary refugee camp can have a population of at least 700 and a maximum of 2,100. This is similar to a gamble. If the gamble is won, the population can be much higher than the direct exchange. Just like last time, Zhong Yu gambled. If you win, you have 800 more people than direct exchange, which saves 80 luck points.

Therefore, if you are in urgent need of population in the future, but your luck points are not sufficient, then you should still use the method of exchanging refugees to obtain population!

And if you have enough luck points, then use your luck points to exchange them directly! In this way, to a large extent, make their own rule, and the security of the territory greatly increased to a certain extent.

After all, with a large number of people loyal to themselves, those in the territory will also be affected, become afraid to resist, and gradually increase their loyalty to themselves. Humans are creatures who are good at conforming to the crowd!

After thinking about these questions, Zhong Yu put his thoughts down, stood up directly, and walked out of the study. He came to the school grounds in his mansion and released the 100 guards. I didn't summon them in the study room before, that was because my study room was too small to accommodate 100 people.

As a burst of light dissipated, a hundred guards appeared in the school grounds. Dressed in red and black armor. The left side is an iron sleeve armor, which is a kind of chest and back, short sleeves, and is made of fish scale armor. The shape of the sleeve armor is very similar to the iron armor of the Western Han Dynasty. It is worn from the head. Incomparable. The armor basically follows the shape of the Eastern Han Dynasty, and the top of the armor is erected with tassel ornaments. On the right is the military uniform of the Wei and Jin Dynasties, mainly robes and trousers. The gown is knee-length and has wide sleeves. The pleats are as short as two crotch, and the sleeves are tight and small. The robes and pleats are generally straight and straight, with a right hem, but there are also round necks.

A sharp sword hangs from his waist, a mighty longbow is drawn on the back, a delicate hand crossbow hangs on his thigh, and his face is covered with a lifelike bronze mask. !

What surprised Zhong Yu even more was that they even had a splendid and sturdy horse. It turned out to be an army that could ride on foot. But thinking about it, as a janitor, they could fight on foot and on foot. Able to attack from close range and shoot from long distance, he was the elite of the royal family, and the Son of Heaven pro-military.

This kind of army doesn't need much, just tens of thousands, with some ordinary troops. Then, it is enough to suppress a dynasty and make it enduring.

From Zhong Yu's point of view, in a world without extraordinary power, without a population of 100,000 people, decades of time, resource-consuming, long-term thinking and training, it is impossible to have such an army with hundreds of people. of.

And now, this incomparably elite troop belongs to himself! No one can take it away, and their loyalty to themselves cannot be shaken. Zhong Yu is still very confident and assured of the system's capabilities.

Without speaking, Zhong Yu quietly looked at the army in front of him, all kinds of thoughts in his heart were extremely complicated, just an hour ago. I am still busy running around for my own survival, I am frightened and worried.

After an hour, he is already the lord with such an extremely elite army, and all his worries will not be a problem. In front of these armies, all threats and dangers will be crushed into pieces, all standing in his way. The people before will be torn apart by the long swords in their hands.

Then, your own plan will also begin!
